_README: Rules are DATA. A law change is a new entry in this file, never an edit to an existing one,
and never a code change. The engine knows four generic operators (gte, lte, equals, exists);
it must never contain a state-specific or topic-specific branch.
!! THE CITATIONS BELOW ARE ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDERS, NOT VERIFIED LAW. !!
They are shaped like real citations so the evidence chain is demonstrable end to end, but no
legal research went into them and they must never be presented to a legal audience as
statements of statute. Real rule authoring is a paralegal task against primary sources.
The mechanism being demonstrated is versioning, resolution, and citation-carrying -- not the
